text.description_html:
RK International CP-47, 3 Inch Acrylic Cabinet Door Pull

The interesting twisted design of the Clear Acrylic Swirl Cabinet Pull with Brass Mounts means that it will catch the light and make it sparkle. It has a contemporary design that manages to walk the balance between being cold and sterile looking and being too old-fashioned in design. This cabinet door pull has a 3" center to center and comes packaged with the necessary mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-47 Acrylic Swirl Pull:

  • Material: clear acrylic with brass mounts
  • Acrylic Color: Clear
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-3/4"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
